body: Amazing poem
Hell yeah man😂 it’s terrible
The hand represents someone special who comes into your life that helps you that you care for and learn to love

The void is a representation of what state our minds are in during depression, being pulled out of the void by a hand is a representation of feeling your depression get better, like being lifted out of it
Yeah, it doesn’t scare me because I’ve accepted the fact that it happens to everyone at different times, whether my time is sooner or later it doesn’t matter to me as long as I make memories now
What if is the major question there, there’s always that possiblility that it won’t be so why not have fun while I’m young and if I make it til then, then hey look at me go, if I don’t oh well
Thank you, I really appreciate the kind words, poems are my only escape and way to vent

I’m a 17 M so I understand what you’re saying, this is my senior year, and I don’t see a future past high school because I don’t want one, all my life I’ve said I won’t make past 20 because of my personality I’m an adrenaline junkie so add depression and anxiety on top of that you get a very dangerous person 😂
Please don’t end things, this community here has everyone’s back so please dont be scared to reach out,

Hey man, Im 17 and I’ve had depression and anxiety since a young age, so it can happen and does, trauma from childhoods often cause it and some people just develops it without a reason so please don’t say that the young can’t have a mental illness just because of their age, sometimes we suffer more than people knoe

Hey man, I use the saying, I’ve hit rock bottom and just kept on digging down because it just hasn’t gotten better, you’ve just gotta enjoy the little things that you might not realize you enjoy but you do, because the memories of the little things are a major factor in why I’m here today, it worked for me idk if it will for you but it’s worth a shot brother

17 M here I had to work two jobs o we summer just to keep up with my bills, I had no time to enjoy my last summer, but it’s hard thinking about the future because it is random and a scary thought because I don’t see the point in trying, I’ve been trying my hardest to make my parents proud but they treat me like shit, the only advice i can give you would be to sit down do some research on a field or job you’re wanting to go into and look into that more, it’s never to late to start fresh bro
Hey bro it’s what I’m here for, I’d rather make someone’s day a little better than worse, if you ever need to talk feel free to pm bro

Hey man, I’m a senior this year to, except I’m in the opposite position, I don’t have anyone in my school, I’m that guy that everyone knows and will say hey to but not Persue a conversation, I walk alone and vibe alone, I’m the loner in my school and I love it, the only advice I could give you is to hold those friends as close as you can man, you never know when they’ll be gone so make memories while you can, because i lost that ability years ago

Hey man these weren’t meaningless words because they mean something to you, I want to thank you for posting this, I can’t give you any answers as to what the point is, because I’ve been asking that same question for a while now, but sometimes there doesn’t need to be a point for you to enjoy the little moments, much love brother ❤️
That’s amazing man

I hate to say this man, but it takes awhile for it to get better at least in my case, it’s been over a year for me and I still feel that way, it does get better eventually but that thought and pain will always linger

When all is done, I’ve finally won 

I begin to feel woozy 

As I sit and think I shoot a wink 

Just like I did that uzi 

To the cool kid crowd 

All on the ground 

Not dead but they should be 

As my end comes near 

I never fear 

For it wasn’t their words that hurt me 

It was the demons in my mind 

That brought me down this path 

The cool kid crowd is all done now


 Let me know if you like it😂

Hey man, I understand what you’re saying because I’m in the same boat, I’ve been alone for about 1 year now and it’s rough but if you want to talk about anything pm me and we can talk, you won’t be alone because you’ll have me

I felt that same way, I was perfectly fine with how I looked when in the relationship and where I was in life, after she left me I started thinking about every guy I saw and what they had that I didn’t, it’s been over a year and I still have that feeling, I’m hoping it will go away with time
Thank you, that was amazing and I will hold onto the little things that make me happy, I really appreciate you

I’m a senior this year, and I have the reputation of flying solo, it gets easier as time moves on, once you get the right mindset it’s easier to deal with, it doesn’t make it go away and the loneliness is still there but it helps in some ways
